page.overview:
Who is Super Ice Drone?

The Super Ice Drone is an Alpha Team minifigure introduced in 2005.

The Super Ice Drone's design is derived from the standard Ice Drone, but with some notable differences. The torso, left arm, and left leg are black, while the rest of the uniform is dark red. The torso is printed with the shape of a scarab; unlike normal Ice Drones, this scarab has a white outline. The Super Ice Drone has a unique black "evil" skull with white outlines and glowing red eyes, and wears a transparent fluorescent blue Insect Helm.

The Super Ice Drone is a special type of Ice Drone that pilots the Scorpion Orb Launcher, which is pursued by Flex and his ice glider. Little else is known about the Super Ice Drone, since it does not appear in the theme's storyline in any capacity; the LEGO Magazine comics instead depict Ogel piloting the Scorpion Orb Launcher during the final battle.
